note: Proposed checks based on the available warehouse schema. Verify against the assignment's original dq_checks_catalog when available.

checks.name: Employee ID is missing
checks.description: An employee record has no employee ID, so it cannot be reliably identified.

checks.name: Employee ID is duplicated
checks.description: Two employee records share the same employee ID, which can cause incorrect employee counts or joins.

checks.name: Employee exit date precedes hire date
checks.description: An employee appears to have left before joining the company.

checks.name: Employment status is invalid
checks.description: An employee has an employment status outside the approved values.

checks.name: Salary structure ID is duplicated
checks.description: Multiple salary structure rows share an ID that should uniquely identify a record.

checks.name: Salary amount is negative
checks.description: A salary component has a negative monthly amount.

checks.name: Attendance ID is duplicated
checks.description: Multiple attendance records share the same attendance ID.

checks.name: Attendance status is invalid
checks.description: An attendance record uses a status outside the observed approved status list.

checks.name: Overtime hours are negative
checks.description: An attendance record reports fewer than zero overtime hours.

checks.name: Leave end date precedes start date
checks.description: A leave request ends before it begins.

checks.name: Leave request ID is duplicated
checks.description: Multiple leave requests share the same request ID.

checks.name: Payroll period dates are invalid
checks.description: A payroll run ends before its start date.

checks.name: Payroll item ID is duplicated
checks.description: Multiple payroll item records share the same payroll item ID.

checks.name: Payroll net pay does not reconcile
checks.description: Net pay differs from gross pay minus total deductions by more than 0.01.
